platform/create/provision-wizard.name: ProvisionWizard
platform/create/provision-wizard.title: Templates/Platform/Create/ProvisionWizard
platform/create/provision-wizard.summary: A two-step creation wizard that provisions a resource and binds it to another: the creation header, a Stepper rail that only lets you go back, a page heading over the form column, and a footer that fades in over the canvas with Back and the primary action, Next and then Create and deploy. Step one binds the project the service serves, either an existing one from the paged list (ResourcePicker) or a new one whose cache settings and origin are set right there. Step two reads the chosen project back with a Change button, then asks for the domain (a free platform-domain prefix or your own hostname, previewed as the address traffic arrives on), the environment and certificate, the deployment the first release is cut against, and an Advanced disclosure. Submitting runs the provisioning log plotted in DeploymentFlow and ends on DeploySuccess. Built from `PageHeader`, `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, `GlobalHeader`, `Stepper`, `Card`, `ToggleGroup`, `Field`, `Label`, `Input`, `HelperText`, `Item`, `Skeleton`, `Switch`, `RadioCards`, `Select`, `Hint` and `Button`.

  const platformDomainSuffix = '.example.com'
  const PAGE_SIZE = 5
  const wireWidths = ['62%', '48%', '70%', '54%', '44%']
  const wireSubWidths = ['84%', '66%', '78%', '58%', '72%']

  const usePicker = (options, noun, initial = {}) => {
    const query = ref('')
    const chosen = ref(initial.chosen ?? '')
    const message = ref(initial.message ?? '')
    const shown = ref(PAGE_SIZE)
    const loading = ref(initial.loading ?? false)

    const chosenIndex = options.findIndex((option) => option.value === chosen.value)
    if (chosenIndex >= PAGE_SIZE) shown.value = Math.ceil((chosenIndex + 1) / PAGE_SIZE) * PAGE_SIZE

    const paged = computed(() => options.length > PAGE_SIZE)
    const matches = computed(() => {
      const text = query.value.trim().toLowerCase()
      if (!text) return options
      return options.filter(
        (option) =>
          option.label.toLowerCase().includes(text) ||
          String(option.description ?? '')
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(text)
      )
    })
    const visible = computed(() => matches.value.slice(0, shown.value))
    const remaining = computed(() => Math.max(0, matches.value.length - visible.value.length))
    const nextBatch = computed(() => Math.min(PAGE_SIZE, remaining.value))

    const summary = computed(() => {
      if (loading.value) return 'Loading ' + nextBatch.value + ' more ' + noun + 's'
      if (query.value.trim() && !matches.value.length)
        return 'No ' + noun + ' matches ' + query.value
      if (remaining.value)
        return visible.value.length + ' of ' + matches.value.length + ' ' + noun + 's'
      return query.value.trim()
        ? matches.value.length + ' of ' + options.length + ' ' + noun + 's'
        : options.length + ' ' + noun + 's'
    })

    const loadMore = () => {
      if (loading.value || !remaining.value) return
      loading.value = true
      setTimeout(() => {
        shown.value += PAGE_SIZE
        loading.value = false
      }, 420)
    }

    return reactive({
      query,
      chosen,
      message,
      loading,
      paged,
      matches,
      visible,
      remaining,
      nextBatch,
      summary,
      loadMore
    })
  }

  const stepIndex = ref(0)
  const steps = computed(() =>
    wizardSteps.map((entry, position) => ({
      value: entry.id,
      title: entry.label,
      description: entry.description ?? '',
      state: position < stepIndex.value ? 'complete' : 'upcoming',
      disabled: position > stepIndex.value
    }))

  const current = computed({
    get: () => wizardSteps[stepIndex.value].id,
    set: (value) => {
      const position = wizardSteps.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === value)
      if (position !== -1 && position < stepIndex.value) stepIndex.value = position

    },

  })

    domainPrefix: '',
    domainHost: '',
    name: '',
    environment: 'Production',
    certificate: 'shared_san',
    deploymentMode: 'auto',
    minimumTlsVersion: 'tls_1_2',
    errorPage: '',
    allowPlatformDomain: true,
    active: true
  })
  const errors = reactive({})
  const advancedOpen = ref(false)

  const slug = (value) =>
    String(value ?? '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')

  const names = computed(() => {
    const input = slug(form.domainType === 'own' ? form.name : form.domainPrefix)
    return {
      service: input,
      deployment: input ? input + '-deployment' : '',
      domain:
        form.domainType === 'own'
          ? form.domainHost.trim().toLowerCase() || (input ? input + platformDomainSuffix : '')
          : input
            ? input + platformDomainSuffix
            : ''
    }
  })

  const boundName = computed(() =>
    projectMode.value === 'new' ? projectName.value.trim() : projectPicker.chosen
  )

  const projectSummary = computed(() => {
    if (!boundName.value) return 'Not chosen yet. Pick one, or create it with the service.'
    if (projectMode.value !== 'new') {
      return 'Serving its latest ready version. The domain answers with this.'
    }
    return 'Created with the service and built before the release is cut.'
  })

  const originFields = computed(() => originFieldsByType[scratch.origin.type])

  const labelFor = (options) => (value) =>
    options.find((option) => option.value === value)?.label ?? ''

  const validate = () => {
    Object.keys(errors).forEach((key) => delete errors[key])
    projectPicker.message = ''
    deploymentPicker.message = ''
    if (stepIndex.value === 0) {
      if (!boundName.value) {
        projectPicker.message =
          projectMode.value === 'new'
            ? 'Name the project, or select one that already exists.'
            : 'Select the project this service serves, or create a new one.'
      }
      if (projectMode.value === 'new') {
        if (scratch.cache.images.enabled && !scratch.cache.images.values.extensions?.trim()) {
          errors['cache.images.extensions'] = 'This field is required.'
        }
        if (scratch.origin.enabled) {
          for (const field of originFields.value) {
            if (field.required && !String(scratch.origin.values[field.name] ?? '').trim()) {
              errors['origin.' + field.name] = 'This field is required.'
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return !projectPicker.message && Object.keys(errors).length === 0
    }
    if (form.domainType === 'own') {
      if (!form.domainHost.trim())
        errors.domainHost = 'Enter the hostname that points at this service.'
      if (!form.name.trim()) errors.name = 'Name the service.'
    } else if (!form.domainPrefix.trim()) {
      errors.domainPrefix = 'Enter the prefix for the platform domain.'
    }
    if (form.deploymentMode === 'existing' && !deploymentPicker.chosen) {
      deploymentPicker.message = 'Select the deployment the first release lands in.'
    }
    return Object.keys(errors).length === 0 && !deploymentPicker.message
  }

  const advance = () => {
    if (!validate()) return
    if (stepIndex.value < wizardSteps.length - 1) stepIndex.value += 1
  }

  const nextLabel = computed(() =>
    stepIndex.value === wizardSteps.length - 1 ? 'Create and deploy' : 'Next'
  )

  const usePicker = (options, noun, initial = {}) => {
    const query = ref('')
    const chosen = ref(initial.chosen ?? '')
    const message = ref(initial.message ?? '')
    const shown = ref(PAGE_SIZE)
    const loading = ref(initial.loading ?? false)

    const chosenIndex = options.findIndex((option) => option.value === chosen.value)
    if (chosenIndex >= PAGE_SIZE) shown.value = Math.ceil((chosenIndex + 1) / PAGE_SIZE) * PAGE_SIZE

    const paged = computed(() => options.length > PAGE_SIZE)
    const matches = computed(() => {
      const text = query.value.trim().toLowerCase()
      if (!text) return options
      return options.filter(
        (option) =>
          option.label.toLowerCase().includes(text) ||
          String(option.description ?? '')
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(text)
      )
    })
    const visible = computed(() => matches.value.slice(0, shown.value))
    const remaining = computed(() => Math.max(0, matches.value.length - visible.value.length))
    const nextBatch = computed(() => Math.min(PAGE_SIZE, remaining.value))

    const summary = computed(() => {
      if (loading.value) return 'Loading ' + nextBatch.value + ' more ' + noun + 's'
      if (query.value.trim() && !matches.value.length)
        return 'No ' + noun + ' matches ' + query.value
      if (remaining.value)
        return visible.value.length + ' of ' + matches.value.length + ' ' + noun + 's'
      return query.value.trim()
        ? matches.value.length + ' of ' + options.length + ' ' + noun + 's'
        : options.length + ' ' + noun + 's'
    })

    const loadMore = () => {
      if (loading.value || !remaining.value) return
      loading.value = true
      setTimeout(() => {
        shown.value += PAGE_SIZE
        loading.value = false
      }, 420)
    }

    return reactive({
      query,
      chosen,
      message,
      loading,
      paged,
      matches,
      visible,
      remaining,
      nextBatch,
      summary,
      loadMore
    })
  }

  const errors = reactive({})

  const slug = (value) =>

      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')

  const names = computed(() => {
    const input = slug(form.domainType === 'own' ? form.name : form.domainPrefix)
    return {
      service: input,
      deployment: input ? input + '-deployment' : '',
      domain:
        form.domainType === 'own'
          ? form.domainHost.trim().toLowerCase() || (input ? input + platformDomainSuffix : '')
          : input
            ? input + platformDomainSuffix
            : ''
    }
  })

  const boundName = computed(() =>
    projectMode.value === 'new' ? projectName.value.trim() : projectPicker.chosen
  )

  const projectSummary = computed(() => {
    if (!boundName.value) return 'Not chosen yet. Pick one, or create it with the service.'
    if (projectMode.value !== 'new') {
      return 'Serving its latest ready version. The domain answers with this.'
    }
    return 'Created with the service and built before the release is cut.'
  })

  const originFields = computed(() => originFieldsByType[scratch.origin.type])

  const labelFor = (options) => (value) =>
    options.find((option) => option.value === value)?.label ?? ''

  const validate = () => {
    Object.keys(errors).forEach((key) => delete errors[key])
    projectPicker.message = ''
    deploymentPicker.message = ''
    if (stepIndex.value === 0) {
      if (!boundName.value) {
        projectPicker.message =
          projectMode.value === 'new'
            ? 'Name the project, or select one that already exists.'
            : 'Select the project this service serves, or create a new one.'
      }
      if (projectMode.value === 'new') {
        if (scratch.cache.images.enabled && !scratch.cache.images.values.extensions?.trim()) {
          errors['cache.images.extensions'] = 'This field is required.'
        }
        if (scratch.origin.enabled) {
          for (const field of originFields.value) {
            if (field.required && !String(scratch.origin.values[field.name] ?? '').trim()) {
              errors['origin.' + field.name] = 'This field is required.'
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return !projectPicker.message && Object.keys(errors).length === 0
    }
    if (form.domainType === 'own') {
      if (!form.domainHost.trim())
        errors.domainHost = 'Enter the hostname that points at this service.'
      if (!form.name.trim()) errors.name = 'Name the service.'
    } else if (!form.domainPrefix.trim()) {
      errors.domainPrefix = 'Enter the prefix for the platform domain.'
    }
    if (form.deploymentMode === 'existing' && !deploymentPicker.chosen) {
      deploymentPicker.message = 'Select the deployment the first release lands in.'
    }
    return Object.keys(errors).length === 0 && !deploymentPicker.message
  }

  const advance = () => {
    if (!validate()) return
    if (stepIndex.value < wizardSteps.length - 1) stepIndex.value += 1

  const platformDomainSuffix = '.example.com'
  const PAGE_SIZE = 5
  const wireWidths = ['62%', '48%', '70%', '54%', '44%']
  const wireSubWidths = ['84%', '66%', '78%', '58%', '72%']

  const usePicker = (options, noun, initial = {}) => {
    const query = ref('')
    const chosen = ref(initial.chosen ?? '')
    const message = ref(initial.message ?? '')
    const shown = ref(PAGE_SIZE)
    const loading = ref(initial.loading ?? false)

    const chosenIndex = options.findIndex((option) => option.value === chosen.value)
    if (chosenIndex >= PAGE_SIZE) shown.value = Math.ceil((chosenIndex + 1) / PAGE_SIZE) * PAGE_SIZE

    const paged = computed(() => options.length > PAGE_SIZE)
    const matches = computed(() => {
      const text = query.value.trim().toLowerCase()
      if (!text) return options
      return options.filter(
        (option) =>
          option.label.toLowerCase().includes(text) ||
          String(option.description ?? '')
            .toLowerCase()
            .includes(text)
      )
    })
    const visible = computed(() => matches.value.slice(0, shown.value))
    const remaining = computed(() => Math.max(0, matches.value.length - visible.value.length))
    const nextBatch = computed(() => Math.min(PAGE_SIZE, remaining.value))

    const summary = computed(() => {
      if (loading.value) return 'Loading ' + nextBatch.value + ' more ' + noun + 's'
      if (query.value.trim() && !matches.value.length)
        return 'No ' + noun + ' matches ' + query.value
      if (remaining.value)
        return visible.value.length + ' of ' + matches.value.length + ' ' + noun + 's'
      return query.value.trim()
        ? matches.value.length + ' of ' + options.length + ' ' + noun + 's'
        : options.length + ' ' + noun + 's'
    })

    const loadMore = () => {
      if (loading.value || !remaining.value) return
      loading.value = true
      setTimeout(() => {
        shown.value += PAGE_SIZE
        loading.value = false
      }, 420)
    }

    return reactive({
      query,
      chosen,
      message,
      loading,
      paged,
      matches,
      visible,
      remaining,
      nextBatch,
      summary,
      loadMore
    })
  }

  const stepIndex = ref(1)
  const steps = computed(() =>
    wizardSteps.map((entry, position) => ({
      value: entry.id,
      title: entry.label,
      description: entry.description ?? '',
      state: position < stepIndex.value ? 'complete' : 'upcoming',
      disabled: position > stepIndex.value
    }))
  )

  const current = computed({
    get: () => wizardSteps[stepIndex.value].id,
    set: (value) => {
      const position = wizardSteps.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === value)
      if (position !== -1 && position < stepIndex.value) stepIndex.value = position
    }
  })

  const goBack = () => {
    if (stepIndex.value > 0) stepIndex.value -= 1
  }

  const projectMode = ref('existing')
  const projectName = ref('')
  const projectPicker = usePicker(projects, 'project', { chosen: 'web-app' })
  const deploymentPicker = usePicker(deployments, 'deployment')
  const scratch = reactive({
    cache: {
      images: {
        enabled: false,
        values: { extensions: 'jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, avif, svg, ico, bmp, tiff' }
      },
      'files-optimization': { enabled: false, values: {} }
    },
    origin: { enabled: false, type: 'http', values: {} }
  })

  const form = reactive({
    domainType: 'platform',
    domainPrefix: 'my-first-app',
    domainHost: '',
    name: '',
    environment: 'Production',
    certificate: 'shared_san',
    deploymentMode: 'auto',
    minimumTlsVersion: 'tls_1_2',
    errorPage: '',
    allowPlatformDomain: true,
    active: true
  })
  const errors = reactive({})
  const advancedOpen = ref(false)

  const slug = (value) =>
    String(value ?? '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9-]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '')

  const names = computed(() => {
    const input = slug(form.domainType === 'own' ? form.name : form.domainPrefix)
    return {
      service: input,
      deployment: input ? input + '-deployment' : '',
      domain:
        form.domainType === 'own'
          ? form.domainHost.trim().toLowerCase() || (input ? input + platformDomainSuffix : '')
          : input
            ? input + platformDomainSuffix
            : ''
    }
  })

  const boundName = computed(() =>
    projectMode.value === 'new' ? projectName.value.trim() : projectPicker.chosen
  )

  const projectSummary = computed(() => {
    if (!boundName.value) return 'Not chosen yet. Pick one, or create it with the service.'
    if (projectMode.value !== 'new') {
      return 'Serving its latest ready version. The domain answers with this.'
    }
    return 'Created with the service and built before the release is cut.'
  })

  const originFields = computed(() => originFieldsByType[scratch.origin.type])

  const labelFor = (options) => (value) =>
    options.find((option) => option.value === value)?.label ?? ''

  const validate = () => {
    Object.keys(errors).forEach((key) => delete errors[key])
    projectPicker.message = ''
    deploymentPicker.message = ''
    if (stepIndex.value === 0) {
      if (!boundName.value) {
        projectPicker.message =
          projectMode.value === 'new'
            ? 'Name the project, or select one that already exists.'
            : 'Select the project this service serves, or create a new one.'
      }
      if (projectMode.value === 'new') {
        if (scratch.cache.images.enabled && !scratch.cache.images.values.extensions?.trim()) {
          errors['cache.images.extensions'] = 'This field is required.'
        }
        if (scratch.origin.enabled) {
          for (const field of originFields.value) {
            if (field.required && !String(scratch.origin.values[field.name] ?? '').trim()) {
              errors['origin.' + field.name] = 'This field is required.'
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return !projectPicker.message && Object.keys(errors).length === 0
    }
    if (form.domainType === 'own') {
      if (!form.domainHost.trim())
        errors.domainHost = 'Enter the hostname that points at this service.'
      if (!form.name.trim()) errors.name = 'Name the service.'
    } else if (!form.domainPrefix.trim()) {
      errors.domainPrefix = 'Enter the prefix for the platform domain.'
    }
    if (form.deploymentMode === 'existing' && !deploymentPicker.chosen) {
      deploymentPicker.message = 'Select the deployment the first release lands in.'
    }
    return Object.keys(errors).length === 0 && !deploymentPicker.message
  }

  const advance = () => {
    if (!validate()) return
    if (stepIndex.value < wizardSteps.length - 1) stepIndex.value += 1
  }

  const nextLabel = computed(() =>
    stepIndex.value === wizardSteps.length - 1 ? 'Create and deploy' : 'Next'

                                                wireSubWidths[(index - 1) % wireSubWidths.length]

                              </div>

                          </Card>
                        </div>

                        <SettingsSection
                          title="Advanced"
                          hint="Every field here already carries the endpoint's own default, and all of them can be changed once the service exists."
                          v-model:open="advancedOpen"
                          icon="pi pi-cog"

                              </div>

                              <h3
                                class="border-t border-(--border-default) px-(--spacing-md) pb-(--spacing-xs) pt-(--spacing-md) text-label-sm text-(--text-muted)"
                              >
                                Behavior
                              </h3>
                              <Item.List>
                                <SettingRow
                                  title="Allow the platform domain"
                                  kind="compact"
                                >
                                  <template #description>
                                    Serve traffic on the provisioned
                                    {{

                                        : 'platform domain'

                                  </template>

                      </div>

platform/create/resource-picker.name: ResourcePicker
platform/create/resource-picker.title: Templates/Platform/Create/ResourcePicker
platform/create/resource-picker.summary: The card a create flow uses to bind one resource to another: a lead, a ToggleGroup choosing between an existing resource and a new one, then either a hint over a searchable list of the existing resources with a selected mark, paged five at a time with skeleton rows while the next page loads and a polite status line for screen readers, or a Name `Field` around an `Input` whose helper text carries the allowed characters and turns into the required message once Next is pressed empty. The ToggleGroup disappears and the card opens on New when nothing exists to bind. ProvisionWizard binds its project with it on the first step, and its second step reuses the same paged list to pick an existing deployment. Built from `Card`, `ToggleGroup`, `Field`, `Input`, `HelperText`, `Item`, `Skeleton` and `Button`.

variants.name: New
variants.summary: New project: the list gives way to a Name field with the allowed characters as helper text. It only reads as required once Next is pressed with it empty.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: Loading the next page: five skeleton rows with staggered wire widths follow the visible projects while the load button spins.

variants.name: Required
variants.summary: Next pressed with no project selected: the required message sits under the search, above the list.

platform/create/single-page-create.name: SinglePageCreate
platform/create/single-page-create.title: Templates/Platform/Create/SinglePageCreate
platform/create/single-page-create.summary: The page a first-level resource is created on in one screen: its own creation header with no sidebar, a centred form column opening with a small page heading, then stacked sections, each a heading with a Hint over a flush Card of field rows, and a fixed bar under the scrolling form, the same bar Version Detail uses, carrying an optional leading slot plus Cancel and the submit Button. The same page covers a resource with a General section and a collapsed Advanced section, and an action whose submit label follows what it does (Save, Purge, Create). A long create such as Create Service groups `Item` rows under small headings and ends in a full-bleed sticky footer. Fields flag required or invalid only after the submit Button is pressed, and each error clears as soon as its field is edited. Built from `PageHeader`, `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, `SaveBar`, `GlobalHeader`, `IconButton`, `Breadcrumb`, `Avatar`, `Hint`, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `HelperText`, `Switch`, `Field` choice cards with `RadioButton`, `Textarea`, `Alert`, `MultiSelect`, `NumberInput` and `Button`. ImportFromGit is the same job inside the platform shell with standalone `Field` stacks under plain headings instead of `Item` rows: the Git scope and repository side by side, Template Settings, Deployment, Build and Runtime, Notifications and Alerts and Delivery features, ending with an acknowledgement checkbox and a single Deploy button at the end of the column, with no sticky footer; ImportFromGitSubmitted is that form after Deploy on the untouched fields.

variants.name: CreatePurge
variants.summary: Create Purge: a Target section of wide rows choosing the Layer and the Purge Type with RadioButton choice cards, an Arguments section whose code-font Textarea follows the chosen type, a warning Alert, and a bar with only Cancel and Purge. Choosing Tiered Cache leaves Cache Key as the only allowed type.

variants.name: CreateService
variants.summary: A long create, Create Service, in five groups of Item rows (General, Delivery Settings, Origins, Cache Expiration Policies and Debug Rules) over a full-bleed sticky footer with Cancel and Save: Name and Address empty, HTTP port 80 preselected, HTTPS ports disabled until a protocol with HTTPS is chosen, and the host header prefilled with ${host}.

variants.name: RequiredFields
variants.summary: Create Service after Save on the empty form: Name and Address carry the required state with This field is required. under them, and typing into either clears its own error.

variants.name: ImportFromGit
variants.summary: Standalone field stacks in one column: the platform shell with an unpadded scroll region, a page heading, then the Git scope and repository side by side and sections of field stacks under plain headings, ending with an acknowledgement checkbox and a single Deploy button at the end of the column, with no sticky footer. Import from Git is the example: Template Settings, Deployment, Build and Runtime, Notifications and Alerts, Delivery features. Every required field flags only after Deploy is pressed, through the field’s own required state and helper text. Built from `PageHeader`, the platform shell, `Label`, `Select`, `Field` (with its `FieldLabel`, `FieldDescription`, `FieldContent` and `FieldTitle` parts and choice cards), `Input`, `InputGroup`, `RadioButton`, `MultiSelect`, `PasswordInput`, `Textarea`, `PhoneInput`, `Switch`, `Checkbox`, `HelperText` and `Button`.

variants.name: ImportFromGitSubmitted

platform/create/source-wizard.name: SourceWizard
platform/create/source-wizard.title: Templates/Platform/Create/SourceWizard
platform/create/source-wizard.summary: A creation wizard that starts a resource from a code source and deploys it: the creation header, a Stepper rail that only lets you go back, the form column, and a footer with Back and the primary action that disappears while a step is answered by a click. It opens on Where it runs, a centred chooser of the service the project deploys to, six at a time with a search, an inline Create Service row and a way to continue without one; then a card of three methods (Import from Git, Sync with the CLI, Start from a template), each of which declares the remaining steps on the rail. The source, repository, target and configure steps of each method, and the provisioning and success screens (DeploymentFlow and DeploySuccess), are not plotted here. Built from `PageHeader`, `GlobalHeader`, `Stepper`, `Field`, `Input`, `Button`, `Card` and `Item`.

variants.name: Method
variants.summary: service-01 chosen: the page heading appears over How do you want to start?, a flush card of the three methods with a chevron each, and only Back in the footer, since picking a method is the answer.

platform/dashboard/activity-outcomes-das.name: ActivityOutcomesDashboard
platform/dashboard/activity-outcomes-das.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/ActivityOutcomesDashboard
platform/dashboard/activity-outcomes-das.summary: An activity outcomes dashboard: what a set of actors requested through the rules and what the rules decided. A page heading with a Refresh IconButton sits over a filter row of `Field`s (time range, actor, outcome and category Selects, and a destination Input that matches an exact host). A grid of seven StatTiles, four per row until the widest screens, counts the outcomes (requests, allowed, blocked, held, approved, denied and over budget), each with its delta against the previous period and a Hint that defines it. Below, a ChartCard plots outcomes over time as a Chart with stacked bars, one series per exclusive outcome in its status color (allowed success, blocked danger, held warning), with a legend that toggles a series and shows its total. Three ChartCards break the same requests down by actor, category and destination with a BarList each, and a last ChartCard holds the request log, a TableRoot with time, actor, an outcome Tag, category, a SeverityTag, destination, method and the rule that decided it. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the time range loads, the tiles, the chart and the breakdowns render their own Skeleton and the log holds Skeleton rows, so the page does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A time range with no request. The tiles show a dash with no delta, the chart and the breakdowns keep their box with an empty state, and the log says what fills it and to widen the time range.

platform/dashboard/alerts-dashboard.name: AlertsDashboard
platform/dashboard/alerts-dashboard.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/AlertsDashboard
platform/dashboard/alerts-dashboard.summary: An alerts dashboard: what is open, how severe it is, what kind it is and who is involved. A page heading with the period Select sits over four StatTiles (open, critical or high open, alerts in the period and the false positive rate), each with its delta and a Hint. Below, a ChartCard stacks the alerts raised each day by severity level, with every series colored from the severity ramp so the bars, the legend and the tooltip read the same scale as the tables. Beside it, Open by severity lists one SeverityTag per level with its open count and its share of the open alerts. A BarList ranks the alerts by type, the Highest risk table pairs each entity with its risk score and the SeverityTag of its worst open alert, and the Open alerts table leads every row with its SeverityTag, sortable from critical to info. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the period loads, the tiles, the chart, the bar list and both tables render their own Skeleton, and Open by severity holds Skeleton rows, so nothing reflows when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A period with no alerts. The tiles show a dash with no delta, and every region keeps its box with an EmptyState that says why it is empty and what to do next.

platform/dashboard/analytics-dashboard.name: AnalyticsDashboard
platform/dashboard/analytics-dashboard.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/AnalyticsDashboard
platform/dashboard/analytics-dashboard.summary: The analytics dashboard pattern: KPI tiles, charts and a table that all read the same period, so one change of range moves every region together. A row of four StatTiles (requests, data transferred, success rate and status 5xx, each with a sparkline and its change against the previous period) sits over a 12-column grid of ChartCards. Requests over time spans the grid as an area Chart, status codes as a multi-series line and requests by country as labeled horizontal bars share a row, and a searchable, paginated TableRoot of top hosts closes it. Every card carries the same header: title with a Hint, the aggregation and variation Tags, a Line or Bar ToggleGroup for time series, an Expand IconButton, and a DropdownMenu with Copy query and Export CSV. Built from `StatTile`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `TableRoot`, `Tag`, `Hint`, `ToggleGroup`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `DropdownMenu`, `Input` and `EmptyState`.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the first response loads, every tile, chart and the table hold their place with a Skeleton, so the grid does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No traffic in the period. The tiles show a dash with no delta or trend, and each card keeps its box with an EmptyState that says nothing was recorded.

platform/dashboard/composition-dashboard.name: CompositionDashboard
platform/dashboard/composition-dashboard.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/CompositionDashboard
platform/dashboard/composition-dashboard.summary: A composition dashboard: how a total breaks down into its parts and how that mix moved over time, here the organization’s monthly spend by category. Under a page heading with the period Select and an Export button sits a row of four StatTiles, the total first and then its three largest categories, each with the change against the previous month and a 12-month sparkline; a rise reads as bad, so every tile is `inverse`. Below, a 12-column grid of ChartCards: the stacked Chart of spend by category over 12 months (Area or Bar from a ToggleGroup, crosshair, one tooltip for every category, a legend with range totals) beside a DonutChart of the current month’s split with the total in its center, and a ranked contributors TableRoot across the full width: rank, the resource name behind its category glyph, the category Tag, the amount, its share of the total as a Progress with the percentage, and the change against last month as a Tag. Built from `PageHeader`, `StatTile`, `Chart`, `DonutChart`, `ChartCard`, `TableRoot`, `Tag`, `Progress`, `Hint`, `ToggleGroup`, `Select`, `DropdownMenu`, `IconButton`, `Button` and `EmptyState`.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the first response loads, every tile, both charts and the table hold their place with a Skeleton, so the grid does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: Nothing was billed in the selected period. The tiles show a dash with no delta or trend, and the stacked chart, the donut and the table each keep their box with an EmptyState that names the reason.

platform/dashboard/configurable-dashboar.name: ConfigurableDashboard
platform/dashboard/configurable-dashboar.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/ConfigurableDashboard
platform/dashboard/configurable-dashboar.summary: A configurable dashboard: the reader arranges the cards. An Edit layout Button turns on the ChartCard drag handle and resize corner on every card of a 12-column grid; a card snaps to whole columns between 3 and 12 and to a height between 280 and 720 pixels. Each card keeps its title with a Hint and nothing else in its header, and shows a Tag with its span while editing. The page owns the layout, an array of id, span and height bound with v-model:span and v-model:height, and the order, which it changes on drop or on the arrow keys of a focused drag handle, then puts focus back on the moved handle and announces the move in a polite live region. Reset layout appears once the layout differs from the default. Keep the layout wherever the product stores preferences. Built from `ChartCard` (with `DragHandle` and `ResizeHandle`), `Chart`, `DonutChart`, `BarList`, `Hint`, `Tag` and `Button`.

variants.name: Editing
variants.summary: Edit mode. Drag a card by its handle onto another to swap their order, or drag its corner to change the span and the height. Focus the handle and use the arrow keys to move a card, or focus the corner and use Left and Right for the span, Up and Down for the height.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the data loads, every chart renders its own Skeleton inside its card, so the layout holds its shape.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: Nothing recorded yet. Each card keeps its place and size and shows its empty state, so the reader can still arrange the dashboard before any data arrives.

platform/dashboard/data-dashboard.name: DataDashboard
platform/dashboard/data-dashboard.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/DataDashboard
platform/dashboard/data-dashboard.summary: The data dashboard pattern: KPI tiles with sparklines and period-over-period deltas, followed by the breakdowns that explain them. Six StatTiles carry each metric’s period total, a sparkline and the change against the previous 24 hours, each with a Hint that defines the metric. Under them, a ChartCard draws data transferred this period over the previous one as two series, a labeled horizontal bar Chart ranks the projects by data transferred, and a searchable, paginated TableRoot lists requests and data transferred per project. Every card keeps its Sum and change Tags, an Expand IconButton and a DropdownMenu with Copy query and Export CSV. Built from `StatTile`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `TableRoot`, `Tag`, `Hint`, `ToggleGroup`, `IconButton`, `Tooltip`, `DropdownMenu`, `Input` and `EmptyState`.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The first response is on its way: Skeletons hold every tile, chart and table row in place.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: No usage recorded yet: each tile shows a dash, and every chart and the table explain that nothing was recorded in the period.

platform/dashboard/executive-summary-das.name: ExecutiveSummaryDashboard
platform/dashboard/executive-summary-das.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/ExecutiveSummaryDashboard
platform/dashboard/executive-summary-das.summary: An executive summary dashboard: one page a lead reads to see how the quarter went. A page heading with the quarter Select and Export sits over a scorecard row of six StatTiles (revenue, monthly active users, net revenue retention, NPS, uptime and cost per request), each with its delta against last quarter and a Hint that defines it. Below, a trend grid of small multiples, one ChartCard per metric with a compact Chart (Area or Line) over the last 12 months and a Tag with the twelve-month change, shares one active index so hovering a month moves the crosshair on every card. A side column holds the goals, a Card of goal bars where each goal shows its label, a status Tag (On track, At risk, Off track), a Progress of current against target and both figures, and the commentary, a Card of Item rows with the author Avatar, role, date and the note itself. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the quarter loads, the tiles and charts render their own Skeleton and the goals and commentary hold Skeleton rows, so the page does not reflow when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A quarter with nothing reported. The tiles show a dash with no delta, every trend card keeps its box with an EmptyState that names the quarter and points to a later one, and the goals and commentary each say what fills them.

platform/dashboard/funnel-cohort-dashboa.name: FunnelCohortDashboard
platform/dashboard/funnel-cohort-dashboa.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/FunnelCohortDashboard
platform/dashboard/funnel-cohort-dashboa.summary: A funnel and cohort dashboard: how people move through the steps from a first visit to a paid plan, and how well each weekly sign-up cohort is retained. The page opens with a heading and one global filter bar, a period and a segment `Select`, so every region renders the same slice. Below it, a row of five `StatTile`s (visitors, sign-ups, activated, paid and overall conversion, each against the previous period with a sparkline) sits over a 12-column grid of `ChartCard`s. The conversion funnel spans the grid: a horizontal, labeled `Chart.Bar` of the steps beside a `TableRoot` that states each step’s users, its share of visitors and the drop-off from the step before. Cohort retention shares the next row: a multi-series `Chart.Line` of retention by week since sign-up, one series per weekly cohort, and a cohort `TableRoot` with each cohort’s size and its week 1 to week 6 retention in tabular figures, where a dash marks a week that has not ended. There is no heatmap: the retention matrix is a plain table, not colored cells. Each card header carries a title with a `Hint` and a menu with Export CSV. Built from `PageHeader`, `Select`, `StatTile`, `ChartCard`, `Chart`, `TableRoot`, `EmptyState`, `Hint`, `DropdownMenu`, `IconButton` and `Button`.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the first response loads, every tile, both charts and both tables hold their place with a Skeleton, so the grid does not reflow when data arrives. The filter bar stays usable.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: The filters match nothing. The tiles show a dash with no delta or trend, and each card keeps its box with an EmptyState that names the filters as the reason and offers Clear filters, which resets the period and the segment.

platform/dashboard/health-score-dashboar.name: HealthScoreDashboard
platform/dashboard/health-score-dashboar.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/HealthScoreDashboard
platform/dashboard/health-score-dashboar.summary: A health score dashboard: how well something performs for the people who use it, read as one score out of 100 and its bands. A page heading with the period Select sits over the overall score, a ChartCard with the figure, its band Tag (Good at 80 or more, Fair from 50 to 79, Poor under 50), the top cause of poor samples and a Line Chart of the score per hour. Two ChartCards rank the score per application and per location in a BarList, lowest first, each row naming its top cause. An hourly score card gives every application a Tracker strip, one block per hour colored by band, with its current band Tag at the end of the row. Under the grid, a Card lists the open incidents as Item rows: what is affected, the cause, how many devices and what share of samples, when it opened, and its band. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`.

platform/dashboard/project-status-dashbo.title: Templates/Platform/Dashboard/ProjectStatusDashboard
platform/dashboard/project-status-dashbo.summary: A project status dashboard: where a project stands against its plan, for one project and sprint at a time. The page opens with a heading over a filter row of two Selects (project and sprint), then a row of four StatTiles (completion, tasks done, open tasks and overdue, each against the previous sprint), over a 12-column grid of ChartCards. A DonutChart splits every task by status (done, in progress, not started, and blocked in the danger color) beside the sprint burndown, a Chart of two Lines (actual story points left against the ideal straight line to zero) tagged with how far behind the sprint runs. The milestone timeline and the at-risk list share the next row: the timeline is an Item list with the date, title and a StatusIndicator per checkpoint, since there is no timeline component; the at-risk list is Item rows with the reason and a Tag. The owners table closes the grid, a data-driven Table with each owner’s Avatar and name, open and done counts, and overdue as a danger Tag. Every card carries the same header: title with a Hint, its tags, and a menu with Copy link and Export CSV. Built from `StatTile`, `ChartCard`, `DonutChart`, `Chart`, `Item`, `StatusIndicator`, `Table`, `Avatar`, `Tag`, `Select`, `Hint`, `DropdownMenu`, `EmptyState`, `Skeleton` and `Button`.

variants.name: Failed
variants.summary: A run whose routing rules were rejected: that step is open on its error output with a Failed Tag and the reason in full, the steps behind it read Skipped, and the Logs row names the failed step beside the view switch.

variants.name: CompleteView
variants.summary: The Complete view of a finished run: every line the pipeline printed as one continuous LogView with its copy button.

variants.name: FailedCompleteView
variants.summary: The Complete view of the failed run: the lines up to the error, as one LogView, nothing from the steps that never ran.

platform/detail/details-page.name: DetailsPage
platform/detail/details-page.title: Templates/Platform/Detail/DetailsPage
platform/detail/details-page.summary: The Overview tab of a resource detail page: the platform shell with the resource breadcrumb, the full-bleed tab bar, then the column that opens on the resource summary card. The resource overview follows it with Get started for a resource made from the CLI, and the same page plots its Versions tab (the versions table) and its Build tab (repository, build configuration and token bands); the service overview ends its breadcrumb on the environment picker and follows the summary with the production checklist and the deployment topology. The summary card on its own, in its resource, service and policy shapes, is the Resource, Service and Policy variants: a subject band with the primary link and the actions, a band of labelled facts, and a state band on the canvas fill. The deployment page sits in the same shell without tabs: a status banner, the Deployment Details card with its Deployment Settings band, and the Deployment Logs card whose header carries the duration or the status and the Phased or Complete switch over the DeploymentLogs steps. The version page of a resource is the VersionDetail template and the deploy drawers opened from these pages are the DeployDrawer template (Templates/Platform/Create/DeployDrawer). The Deployments tab of a resource and of a service is the TableView controls row over a deployments table, scoped to the resource (the resource tab adds a small Deployments heading with Documentation and an outlined Deploy action); the service Settings tab is a variant of Templates/Platform/Edit/EditResource. Built from `PageHeader`, `PageTabs`, `SectionHeader`, `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, `SaveBar`, the platform shell, `Select`, `Tabs`, `TableRoot`, `EmptyState`, `InputGroup`, `Card`, `DropdownMenu`, `Popover`, `Accordion`, `Flow`, `Item`, `Drawer`, `Alert`, `LogView`, `CodeBlock` and `ToggleGroup`; the summary card variants add `Button`, `IconButton`, `Tag`, `StatusIndicator`, `Avatar`, `CopyButton` and `Tooltip`.

variants.name: Resource
variants.summary: The summary card that opens a resource Overview tab: a subject band with the primary link and the actions, a band of labelled facts, and a state band on the canvas fill. It comes in three shapes — a resource, a service with its domains and environments, and a policy — each with its own facts and copy. Built from `Card`, `Button`, `IconButton`, `DropdownMenu`, `Popover`, `Tag`, `StatusIndicator`, `Avatar`, `CopyButton`, `Accordion`, `Alert` and `Tooltip`.

variants.name: Service
variants.summary: The service summary: the domain with its aliases in the overflow popover, the environment menu (shown below md only; from md up the breadcrumb carries the environment) and actions, the custom domains, status, service ID and creation, and the shared Deployment Settings band that expands into its policies.

variants.name: Policy
variants.summary: The policy summary: the resource it protects, a Rules shortcut and actions, then status, environment, rule count, last edit and the enabled modules, and what the policy inspects.

variants.name: ResourceVersions
variants.summary: The Versions tab of the same resource: the small Versions heading with New Version, the controls row (Filter, search, Refresh, Download CSV, Columns) and the paginated versions table, each row with its code-set name and Latest mark, the comment, the state Tag, who built it and when, and the Open configuration or Deploy actions.

variants.name: ResourceBuild
variants.summary: The Build tab of a resource made from the CLI: the small Build heading with an outlined Deploy, the Git repository band holding the Connect your repository card, the Build configuration band with the read-only framework preset and the build and deploy commands, and the Deployment band with the API token. Editing a command raises the save bar.

variants.name: ServiceOverview
variants.summary: A service: the breadcrumb ends on its environment picker, the outlined Deploy action sits on the tab row, the summary carries its Deployment Settings band (its own environment menu shows only below md, where the breadcrumb is hidden), the production checklist expands into a drawer, and the deployment topology runs from domains to storage with Bind controls on the open Policy and Error Page slots.

  const navGroups = [
    {
      items: [
        { id: 'home', label: 'Home', icon: 'pi pi-home', path: '/home' },
        { id: 'projects', label: 'Projects', icon: 'pi pi-folder', path: '/projects' },

      ]
    },
    {
      label: 'Build',
      items: [
        { id: 'resources', label: 'Resources', icon: 'pi pi-box', path: '/resources' },
        { id: 'services', label: 'Services', icon: 'pi pi-server', path: '/services' },
        { id: 'variables', label: 'Variables', icon: 'pi pi-sliders-h', path: '/variables' },
        { id: 'integrations', label: 'Integrations', icon: 'pi pi-link', path: '/integrations' },
        { id: 'templates', label: 'Templates', icon: 'pi pi-clone', path: '/templates' }
      ]
    },
    {
      label: 'Security',
      items: [
        { id: 'domains', label: 'Domains', icon: 'pi pi-globe', path: '/domains' },

platform/states/form-validation.name: FormValidation
platform/states/form-validation.title: Templates/Platform/States/FormValidation
platform/states/form-validation.summary: A standalone form that walks through every state a submit can land in, one story per state, on a single Create Variable page with no card around it: a heading, then `Field`s wrapping `Input`, `Select` and `Textarea` straight on the canvas in the form column, with Cancel and Create at the end of the column. Validation runs only on submit. An empty field takes the `required` state, a filled but wrong one takes `invalid`, and its helper text swaps the guidance for the message, so each field speaks in one place and there is no summary. Submit moves focus to the first field in error. A rejected request that no field owns raises an error `Toast` with Retry and keeps the entries. A rejection a field owns, a key already in use, lands on that field and never toasts. A successful save raises a success `Toast` and clears the form. One `Toaster` is mounted with the form. While the form loads, `Skeleton` rows stand in for the fields and Create is disabled. Every story is wired: press Create with API_TOKEN as the key to get the conflict, or any other valid key to get the success state. Below md the actions stack at full width. Its page-level parts are `PageHeader`. The InSync, Rejected, Reloading and Reloaded variants show where a field-scoped server rejection renders: a Create Service page whose linked origin is deleted by another user while the form is open, so the save lands as a danger `Alert` under the Origin section heading with Reload origins, the Origin select takes the invalid state, and a dashed simulation panel plays the other user; never a toast, never a validation summary.

variants.name: Conflict
variants.summary: The server rejected a value one field owns: the key is already in use. The error lands on Key and nowhere else.

variants.name: Saved
variants.summary: The save went through. A success Toast names the new variable and where it is available, and the form is cleared for the next entry.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: The form while its data loads, such as the environments it offers or the record an edit form opens with. Skeleton rows hold the layout, and Create stays disabled until the fields arrive.

The API rejects the save with a field-scoped error, so it lands as a danger `Alert` under the Origin section heading, the section that owns the broken reference, carrying Reload origins, while the Origin select takes the invalid state. Never a toast, never a validation summary. A dashed simulation panel above the form plays the other user. Same page anatomy as the in-page create form (Templates/Platform/Create/SinglePageCreate): the creation header, section headings over flush `Card` groups of `Item` rows, and a sticky footer, here raised with `z-10`. platform/view/split-view.summary: The events explorer placed in the platform shell, with its navigation entry active: the controls row (Filter popover, event search, Refresh and Download CSV) over the applied filter chips, and the explorer. The explorer pairs a resizable, collapsible fields `Sidebar` (each field a column checkbox and a popover of its top values, grouped in an `Accordion` by category) with the log: the Events, Errors and Avg request time summary, the stacked volume chart whose buckets filter the period on click or drag, and the event `TableRoot`. Clicking a row opens the event document beside the log in a resizable end `Sidebar` when the explorer is wide enough, and in a `Drawer` when it is not.

    if (end) {

      const bound = midnight

      if (date.getTime() > bound.getTime()) return false

    ...coreFields.filter(matchesFieldSearch).map((field) => ({ ...field, locked: true })),
    ...optionalFields.filter(
      (field) => shownColumns.value.includes(field.id) && matchesFieldSearch(field)
    )
  ])

  const fieldCategories = computed(() =>
    eventFieldCategories
      .map((category) => ({
        ...category,
        fields: optionalFields.filter(
          (field) =>
            field.category === category.id &&
            !shownColumns.value.includes(field.id) &&
            matchesFieldSearch(field)
        )
      }))
      .filter((category) => category.fields.length)
  )

  const hasFieldMatches = computed(
    () => shownFields.value.length > 0 || fieldCategories.value.length > 0
  )

  const categoryFilterCount = (category) =>
    category.fields.filter((field) => filters.value[field.id]?.length).length

  const openCategories = ref(['request'])

  const collapsedBeforeSearch = ref(null)
  watch(fieldSearch, (term, previous) => {
    const searching = Boolean(term.trim())
    if (searching && !previous.trim()) collapsedBeforeSearch.value = [...openCategories.value]
    if (searching) {
      openCategories.value = fieldCategories.value.map((category) => category.id)
      return
    }
    openCategories.value = collapsedBeforeSearch.value ?? ['request']
    collapsedBeforeSearch.value = null
  })

  const fieldCounts = computed(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(
      eventFields.map((field) => [field.id, countFieldValues(matchedEvents.value, field.id)])
    )
  )

  const topValues = 6

  const unfilterableFields = new Set(['time', 'sourceLabel'])

  const canFilterField = (field) => !unfilterableFields.has(field.id)

  const topFieldValues = (id) => fieldValueCounts(matchedEvents.value, id).slice(0, topValues)

  const fieldValueOverflow = (id) =>
    Math.max(0, countFieldValues(matchedEvents.value, id) - topValues)

  const isValueApplied = (id, value) => (filters.value[id] ?? []).includes(value)

  const toggleColumn = (id) => {
    shownColumns.value = shownColumns.value.includes(id)
      ? shownColumns.value.filter((shown) => shown !== id)
      : [...shownColumns.value, id]
  }

  const toggleFieldValue = (id, value) => {
    const current = filters.value[id] ?? []
    const next = current.includes(value)
      ? current.filter((applied) => applied !== value)
      : [...current, value]
    filters.value = { ...filters.value, [id]: next }
  }

  const toColumn = (field) => ({
    accessorKey: field.id,
    header: field.label,
    enableSorting: true,
    ...(field.principal ? { principal: true } : {}),
    ...(field.grow ? { grow: field.grow } : {}),
    ...(field.minWidth ? { minWidth: field.minWidth } : {}),
    ...(field.align ? { align: field.align } : {})
  })

  const columns = computed(() => [
    { id: 'detail', header: '', width: 44, align: 'center', hideable: false },
    ...coreFields.map(toColumn),
    ...optionalFields.filter((field) => shownColumns.value.includes(field.id)).map(toColumn)
  ])

  const customCellFields = ['status']
  const genericColumns = computed(() =>
    optionalFields.filter(
      (field) => shownColumns.value.includes(field.id) && !customCellFields.includes(field.id)
    )
  )

  const statusField = eventField('status')

  const statusTone = (status) => {
    if (typeof status !== 'number') return null
    if (status >= 500) return 'error'
    if (status >= 400) return 'warn'
    return 'ok'
  }

  const selectedId = ref('')
  const selectedEvent = computed(
    () => matchedEvents.value.find((event) => event.id === selectedId.value) ?? null
  )
  const documentEvent = ref(null)
  watch(selectedEvent, (event) => {
    if (event) documentEvent.value = event
  })

  const logMinWidth = 480
  const documentMinWidth = 348
  const fieldsPanelWidth = 268

  const explorerEl = ref(null)
  const explorerWidth = ref(0)
  let explorerObserver = null

  const showFieldsPanel = computed(
    () => explorerWidth.value === 0 || explorerWidth.value >= fieldsPanelWidth + logMinWidth
  )

  const isWide = computed(
    () =>
      explorerWidth.value === 0 ||
      explorerWidth.value >= fieldsPanelWidth + logMinWidth + documentMinWidth
  )

  const documentDrawerOpen = ref(false)

  onMounted(() => {
    if (!explorerEl.value) return
    explorerWidth.value = explorerEl.value.offsetWidth
    explorerObserver = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) => {
      explorerWidth.value = entry.contentRect.width
    })
    explorerObserver.observe(explorerEl.value)
  })

  watch(isWide, (wide) => {
    documentDrawerOpen.value = !wide && Boolean(selectedId.value)
  })

  const closeDocument = () => {
    selectedId.value = ''
    documentDrawerOpen.value = false
  }

  const openDocument = (event, row) => {
    selectedId.value = row.id
    documentDrawerOpen.value = !isWide.value
  }

  const documentCollapsed = computed({
    get: () => !selectedEvent.value,
    set: (collapsed) => {
      if (collapsed) closeDocument()
    }
  })

  watch(documentDrawerOpen, (open) => {
    if (!open && !isWide.value) selectedId.value = ''
  })

  const fieldsWidth = ref(fieldsPanelWidth)
  const documentWidth = ref(400)

  const documentMaxWidth = computed(() => {
    if (explorerWidth.value === 0) return Infinity
    const fieldsUsed = showFieldsPanel.value && !fieldsCollapsed.value ? fieldsWidth.value : 0
    return Math.max(documentMinWidth, explorerWidth.value - fieldsUsed - logMinWidth)
  })

  watch(
    [documentMaxWidth, documentWidth],
    ([max, width]) => {
      if (width > max) documentWidth.value = max
    },
    { flush: 'sync' }
  )

  const summaryPriority = [
    'host',
    'requestMethod',
    'requestUri',
    'status',
    'serviceName',
    'serviceDurationMs',
    'ruleName',
    'requestTimeMs',
    'remoteAddress',
    'country',
    'cacheStatus',
    'resourceId'
  ]

  const summaryLimit = 6

  const hasEventValue = (event, id) => {
    const value = event[id]
    return value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== ''
  }

  const documentRows = computed(() => {
    const event = selectedEvent.value
    if (!event) return []
    return summaryPriority
      .filter((id) => hasEventValue(event, id))
      .slice(0, summaryLimit)
      .map((id) => {
        const field = eventField(id)
        return { id, label: field.label, value: formatEventValue(field, event[id]) }
      })
  })

  const documentTabs = computed(() => {
    const event = selectedEvent.value
    if (!event) return []
    const payload = Object.fromEntries(
      eventFields
        .filter((field) => hasEventValue(event, field.id))
        .map((field) => [field.id, event[field.id]])
    )
    return [
      {
        label: 'Document',
        value: 'document',
        language: 'json',
        code: JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2)
      }
    ]
  })

  const hoveredBucket = ref(-1)
  const bucketAnchor = ref(-1)

  const bucketPeak = computed(() => Math.max(1, ...buckets.value.map((bucket) => bucket.total)))

  const busiestIndex = computed(() =>
    buckets.value.reduce(
      (highest, bucket, index) =>
        bucket.total > (buckets.value[highest]?.total ?? 0) ? index : highest,
      0
    )
  )

  const busiestBucket = computed(() => buckets.value[busiestIndex.value] ?? null)

  const activeBucket = computed(() => buckets.value[hoveredBucket.value] ?? null)

  const bucketShare = (value) => `${((value / bucketPeak.value) * 100).toFixed(2)}%`

  const bucketCentre = computed(() =>
    buckets.value.length && hoveredBucket.value >= 0
      ? `${((hoveredBucket.value + 0.5) / buckets.value.length) * 100}%`
      : '0%'
  )

  const bucketCardAlign = computed(() => {
    const count = buckets.value.length
    if (!count || hoveredBucket.value < 0) return 'center'
    if (hoveredBucket.value < count / 5) return 'start'
    if (hoveredBucket.value > (count * 4) / 5) return 'end'
    return 'center'
  })

  const bucketSelection = computed(() => {
    if (bucketAnchor.value < 0 || hoveredBucket.value < 0) return null
    return {
      from: Math.min(bucketAnchor.value, hoveredBucket.value),
      to: Math.max(bucketAnchor.value, hoveredBucket.value)
    }
  })

  const isBucketSelected = (index) => {
    const range = bucketSelection.value
    return Boolean(range && index >= range.from && index <= range.to)
  }

  const enterBucket = (index) => {
    hoveredBucket.value = index
  }

  const leaveChart = () => {
    if (bucketAnchor.value < 0) hoveredBucket.value = -1
  }

  const commitBuckets = () => {
    const range = bucketSelection.value
    bucketAnchor.value = -1
    if (!range) return
    const from = buckets.value[range.from]
    const to = buckets.value[range.to]
    if (!from || !to) return
    selectTimeRange({ start: from.at, end: to.end })
  }

  const releaseBuckets = () => {
    commitBuckets()
    window.removeEventListener('pointerup', releaseBuckets)
  }

  const pressBucket = (index, event) => {
    if (event.button !== 0) return
    bucketAnchor.value = index
    hoveredBucket.value = index
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', releaseBuckets)
    event.preventDefault()
  }

  const stepBucket = (delta) => {
    if (!buckets.value.length) return
    const from = hoveredBucket.value === -1 ? busiestIndex.value : hoveredBucket.value
    hoveredBucket.value = Math.min(Math.max(from + delta, 0), buckets.value.length - 1)
  }

  const applyBucket = () => {
    const bucket = activeBucket.value
    if (bucket) selectTimeRange({ start: bucket.at, end: bucket.end })
  }

  const chartAxis = computed(() => {
    if (!buckets.value.length) return []
    return [
      buckets.value[0],
      buckets.value[Math.floor(buckets.value.length / 2)],
      buckets.value.at(-1)
    ].map((bucket) => formatEventClock(bucket.at))
  })

  const chartSummary = computed(() => {
    if (!busiestBucket.value?.total) return `No events in the ${windowLabel.value.toLowerCase()}.`
    return `Busiest bucket at ${formatEventClock(busiestBucket.value.at)} with ${busiestBucket.value.total} events.`
  })

  const chartLabel = computed(
    () =>
      `Event volume, ${windowLabel.value.toLowerCase()}. ${chartSummary.value} Use the arrow keys to read each bucket and Enter to filter the log to it.`
  )

  const filterCount = computed(
    () => Object.values(filters.value).filter((values) => values?.length).length
  )

  const filterOpen = ref(false)
  const filterFieldId = ref(null)
  const filterQuery = ref('')
  const filterPanel = ref(null)
  const filterRoot = ref(null)
  const filterOriginId = ref(null)
  const filterDirection = ref('forward')
  const customFieldId = ref(null)
  const calendarOpen = ref(false)
  const customRange = ref(null)

  const customFilterField = computed(() =>
    filterFields.value.find((field) => field.id === customFieldId.value)
  )

  const filterField = computed(
    () =>
      filterFields.value.find((field) => field.id === filterFieldId.value) ??
      customFilterField.value
  )

  const filterLevel = computed(() => {
    if (customFieldId.value) return `custom:${customFieldId.value}`
    return filterFieldId.value ? `values:${filterFieldId.value}` : 'fields'
  })

  const filterRegion = ref(null)
  const filterRegionHeight = ref('')
  let releaseFilterHeight = null

  const animateFilterHeight = async (mutate) => {
    const node = filterRegion.value
    if (!node || window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      mutate()
      return
    }
    releaseFilterHeight?.()
    const from = node.offsetHeight
    mutate()
    await nextTick()
    const to = node.offsetHeight
    if (to === from) return
    filterRegionHeight.value = `${from}px`
    let timer = null
    const finish = () => {
      node.removeEventListener('transitionend', onEnd)
      clearTimeout(timer)
      filterRegionHeight.value = ''
      releaseFilterHeight = null
    }
    const onEnd = (event) => {
      if (event.propertyName === 'height' && event.target === node) finish()
    }
    node.addEventListener('transitionend', onEnd)
    timer = setTimeout(finish, 600)
    releaseFilterHeight = finish
    requestAnimationFrame(() =>
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (releaseFilterHeight === finish) filterRegionHeight.value = `${to}px`
      })
    )
  }

  const toFilterLevel = (direction, mutate) => {
    filterDirection.value = direction
    animateFilterHeight(mutate)
  }

  const filterRows = computed(() => {
    const term = filterQuery.value.trim().toLowerCase()
    const source = filterField.value ? (filterField.value.options ?? []) : filterFields.value
    if (!term) return source
    return source.filter((row) => row.label.toLowerCase().includes(term))
  })

  const isPicked = (value) => (filters.value[filterFieldId.value] ?? []).includes(value)

  const enterFilterField = (fieldId) => {
    filterOriginId.value = fieldId
    if (filterOpen.value) {
      toFilterLevel('forward', () => {
        filterFieldId.value = fieldId
        filterQuery.value = ''
      })
      return
    }
    filterFieldId.value = fieldId
    filterQuery.value = ''
    filterOpen.value = true
  }

  const backToFields = () => {
    toFilterLevel('back', () => {
      filterFieldId.value = null
      filterQuery.value = ''
    })
  }

  const focusFilterOrigin = async (id) => {
    await nextTick()
    const field = id ? filterFields.value.find((item) => item.id === id) : null
    const chip =
      field && isApplied(filters.value, field)
        ? document.querySelector(`[data-filter-chip="${id}"]`)
        : null
    ;(chip ?? filterRoot.value?.querySelector('[data-testid="filter-button__trigger"]'))?.focus()
  }

  watch(filterOpen, (isOpen) => {
    if (isOpen) return
    filterFieldId.value = null
    customFieldId.value = null
    calendarOpen.value = false
    customRange.value = null
    filterQuery.value = ''
    filterDirection.value = 'forward'
    const id = filterOriginId.value
    filterOriginId.value = null
    focusFilterOrigin(id)
  })

  const pickFilterOption = (field, option) => {
    if (option.custom) {
      toFilterLevel('forward', () => {
        customFieldId.value = field.id
      })
      calendarOpen.value = true
      return
    }
    filters.value = toggleValue(filters.value, field, option.value)
    if (field.kind === 'range') backToFields()
  }

  const leaveCustomRange = () => {
    calendarOpen.value = false
    customRange.value = null
    toFilterLevel('back', () => {
      customFieldId.value = null
    })
  }

  const commitCustomRange = (range) => {
    const field = customFilterField.value
    if (!field) return
    const next = { ...filters.value }
    if (range?.start || range?.end) next[field.id] = [range]
    else delete next[field.id]
    filters.value = next
    const id = field.id
    leaveCustomRange()
    backToFields()
    filterOpen.value = false
    focusFilterOrigin(id)
  }

  const clearFilterField = (field) => {
    filters.value = clearField(filters.value, field)
  }

  const filterLevelRows = () => [
    ...(filterPanel.value?.querySelectorAll(
      `[data-level="${filterLevel.value}"] [data-filter-row]`
    ) ?? [])
  ]

  const moveFilterFocus = (event, step) => {
    const items = filterLevelRows()
    if (!items.length) return
    event.preventDefault()
    const index = items.indexOf(event.target)
    items[(index + step + items.length) % items.length]?.focus()
  }

  watch(filterLevel, async () => {
    await nextTick()
    filterLevelRows()[0]?.focus()
  })

  const filterChips = computed(() =>
    filterFields.value.filter((field) => isApplied(filters.value, field))
  )

  const summarizeFilter = (field) => summarize(field, filters.value[field.id])

  onBeforeUnmount(() => {
    clearTimeout(refreshTimer)
    explorerObserver?.disconnect()
    window.removeEventListener('pointerup', releaseBuckets)
  })
</script>

    if (end) {
      const midnight =

        end.getMilliseconds() === 0
      const bound = midnight

      if (date.getTime() > bound.getTime()) return false
    }

            matchesFieldSearch(field)
